changelog: Provider artwork now uses lightly rounded corners on the home source button and in the native provider picker.
Navigation labels fit the host bottom bar without replacing its gesture insets or height.
Added an optional transparent app navigation bar; icons and labels remain opaque.
ATTENTION: Enable Show Provider Icons in Home Page settings and choose your artwork source. Transparency is off by default in Navigation settings.
ATTENTION: Restart CloudStream after updating to load the new plugin.
message: v734 - Rounded provider artwork and navigation polish
